# origincloud_network_route_table_associations (Data Source)

Lists a subnet's route table associations: none or one.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project` (String) The project whose route table associations to list.
- `subnet` (String) The subnet whose route table associations to list. Its `id`, the full resource name `//network.origincloudapis.eu/projects/{project}/zones/{zone}/subnets/{subnet}`. `project` and `zone` must be the ones it is in.
- `zone` (String) The zone whose route table associations to list.

### Read-Only

- `route_table_associations` (Attributes List) The route table associations listed, from every page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--route_table_associations))

<a id="nestedatt--route_table_associations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `route_table_associations`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The route table association's full resource name, `//network.origincloudapis.eu/projects/{project}/zones/{zone}/subnets/{subnet}/routeTableAssociations/{route_table_association}`: what an argument that refers to the route table association takes. `name` is the relative name, without the host.
- `name` (String) The association's resource name. Its last segment is the route table's id.
- `route_table` (String) The full name of the route table the subnet uses, in the subnet's VPC.
